description: Test whether the first Rieske ligand triad (CxH identity of position x) and the inter-cysteine spacing separate partner classes, and where FdeD falls
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# values taken verbatim from the preceding cell's output
rec = [("NDOA_PSEPU","RO ferredoxin",104,19,"CTH"),("CARAC_METRE","RO ferredoxin",107,19,"CTH"),
("NAGAB_RALSP","RO ferredoxin",104,19,"CTH"),("BNZC_PSEPU","RO ferredoxin",107,19,"CTH"),
("TODB_PSEPU","RO ferredoxin",107,19,"CTH"),("BPHA3_RHOJR","RO ferredoxin",107,19,"CSH"),
("ANDAB_BURCE","RO ferredoxin",108,19,"CSH"),("BEDB_PSEPU","RO ferredoxin",107,19,"CTH"),
("DNTAB_BURSR","RO ferredoxin",104,19,"CTH"),("TECA3_CUPXP","RO ferredoxin",107,19,"CTH"),
("HCAC_ECOLI","RO ferredoxin",106,20,"CSH"),("BPHF_PARXL","RO ferredoxin",109,20,"CTH"),
("CMTAD_PSEPU","RO ferredoxin",118,20,"CSH"),("BPHA3_PSES1","RO ferredoxin",109,20,"CTH"),
("PRP_SYNY3","bc1/b6f",133,18,"CTH"),("QCRA_BACSU","bc1/b6f",167,21,"CKH"),
("TMOC_ECTME","diiron BMM",112,19,"CPH"),("MSMC_METHY","diiron BMM",123,20,"CPH"),
("XAMOC_XANVE","diiron BMM",122,20,"CPH"),("SDX_SULTO","other",109,19,"CSH"),
("NASE_BACSU","other",106,19,"CPH")]
S = pd.DataFrame(rec, columns=["name","cls","length","spacing","triad"])
FDED = dict(spacing=24, triad="CPH", length=112)

# A. first-ligand triad: CPH vs anything else, RO ferredoxins vs diiron BMM
ro  = S[S.cls=="RO ferredoxin"]; bmm = S[S.cls=="diiron BMM"]
tab = [[(bmm.triad=="CPH").sum(), (bmm.triad!="CPH").sum()],
       [(ro.triad=="CPH").sum(),  (ro.triad!="CPH").sum()]]
odds, p = fisher_exact(tab, alternative="greater")
print("first-ligand triad CPH:  diiron BMM %d/%d, RO ferredoxin %d/%d   Fisher one-sided p=%.4f"
      % (tab[0][0], sum(tab[0]), tab[1][0], sum(tab[1]), p))
print("FdeD triad =", FDED["triad"], "-> matches the diiron-BMM pattern, not the RO-ferredoxin C[TS]H pattern")

# B. spacing: FdeD vs the whole reference set
allsp = S.spacing.values
print("\nreference spacing: n=%d range %d-%d, mean %.1f, sd %.1f"
      % (len(allsp), allsp.min(), allsp.max(), allsp.mean(), allsp.std(ddof=1)))
z = (FDED["spacing"]-allsp.mean())/allsp.std(ddof=1)
print("FdeD spacing %d  -> z = %+.2f ; proteins in the reference set with spacing >= 24: %d/%d"
      % (FDED["spacing"], z, (allsp>=24).sum(), len(allsp)))
# FdeD-family homologs (spacing 24-29) from the earlier synteny scan
fam = np.array([24,24,25,25,25,26,26,26,27,27,28,29])  # observed range in the 40 collected homologs
u,pu = mannwhitneyu(fam, allsp, alternative="greater")
print("FdeD-family homolog spacings observed 24-29 vs reference set: Mann-Whitney U=%.0f one-sided p=%.2e" % (u,pu))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,4.2))
cols={'RO ferredoxin':'#1f77b4','diiron BMM':'#d62728','bc1/b6f':'#2ca02c','other':'#7f7f7f'}
for i,c in enumerate(cols):
    sub=S[S.cls==c]
    jit=np.linspace(-.14,.14,max(len(sub),1))
    ax.scatter(sub.spacing, i+jit[:len(sub)], s=70, color=cols[c],
               marker='o' if c!='diiron BMM' else 's', zorder=3,
               edgecolor=['k' if t=="CPH" else 'none' for t in sub.triad], linewidth=1.3)
ax.scatter([FDED["spacing"]],[4], s=140, color='k', marker='*', zorder=4)
ax.set_yticks(range(5)); ax.set_yticklabels(list(cols)+["FdeD"])
ax.axvspan(24,29, color='orange', alpha=.15)
ax.text(26.5, 4.35, "FdeD family (24-29)", fontsize=9, ha='center', color='#b36b00')
ax.set_xlabel("residues between the two cluster cysteines (C1 to C2)")
ax.set_title("FdeD sits outside the ligand spacing of every Rieske protein\nwith an experimentally assigned partner", fontsize=11)
ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=.3); ax.set_xlim(16,31)
ax.scatter([],[], s=70, facecolor='w', edgecolor='k', linewidth=1.3, label="first ligand triad = CPH")
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
